name: sen_dex
tagline: A background browser extension that maps the concepts you study into a personal knowledge graph without asking you anything.
problem: Keeping up with research means absorbing more information than people can retain.
solution: Collects and filters searches, screen captures and attention hotspots, embeds them and clusters concepts into a navigable map, and predicts papers to read.
demo_moment: Team-described: browse papers and see your concept map grow.

lessons: Passive capture is powerful, but say how private data stays private.
